title: [Automatic update for 2022-02-20]
description: Update manuf, services enterprise numbers, translations, and other items.

notes.body:
Hi @zoranbosnjak, this week's Asterix update caused a build failure:

```
../epan/dissectors/packet-asterix.c:22661:22: error: expected '}'
    { 1, "Number of "too old" messages received" },
                     ^
../epan/dissectors/packet-asterix.c:22661:5: note: to match this '{'
    { 1, "Number of "too old" messages received" },
    ^
../epan/dissectors/packet-asterix.c:23453:22: error: expected '}'
    { 1, "Number of "too old" messages received" },
                     ^
../epan/dissectors/packet-asterix.c:23453:5: note: to match this '{'
    { 1, "Number of "too old" messages received" },
    ^
```

Can you take a look?

added 1 commit
  • ee318cc7 - [Automatic update for 2022-02-20]
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6256/diffs?diff_id=335654666&start_sha=eec156950b16e357da44222ff975d151e4eb7172)

added 2 commits
  • c7f84156 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 695ce22b - [Automatic update for 2022-02-20]
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6256/diffs?diff_id=335654900&start_sha=ee318cc71d7e66eaf248ebc5e7aeebb1e3e14c11)

@geraldcombs

Quotations inside the string were not handled correctly by the conversion script. Unnecessary unicode string replacement was removed at the same time.

Fix is in this merge request:
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6262
